relationships.subject: aging
relationships.evidence_quote: Age demonstrated a statistically significant association with ANF presence, with the odds increasing by approximately 5% for each additional year of age

relationships.subject: atypical corneal nerve formations
relationships.evidence_quote: A statistically significant inverse association was observed with corneal sensitivity

key_findings: Corneal ANFs were found in 25.5% of eyes and their odds rose about 5% per year of age (OR 1.05).
ANFs were inversely associated with corneal sensitivity but not with tear MMP-9, osmolarity, TBUT, OSDI or IVCM metrics.
